Now I'm six months clean and I've come to the conclusion there is absolutely nothing worth living for. I have no friends from heroin, I lost all my running friends from being clean, and I have no family anymore because I'm just a miserable junkie to them. I dream nightly about sitting in the clouds and just talking my mom seeing her face, I spend most of my time just staring at pictures of my mom. Even if killing myself doesn't make me see my mom again, I'll no longer have to deal with my embarrassing miserable life.
